column2: Looks like a stripe-liveried **Ford Mustang, roughly the S197 (2005–2014) or S550 (2015–2023) generation**, going by the rear-view profile and twin racing stripes. I can't pin the generation from this low-detail render.
Looks like a 2015–2020 Ford Mustang (S550, 6th generation) with twin racing stripes, though the low-poly rear view makes the exact generation a best guess.

It looks like a red, late-2010s/2020s Ford Mustang Shelby GT500-style muscle car, with black racing stripes, a rear spoiler and quad exhausts, though the low-poly model is loose enough that the exact generation is a guess.

It looks like a 2010s-era Holden Commodore VF/VE-style sedan or the Ford Falcon-style rear... I'd rather not guess blindly, so here's my best read.  The render is a red, low-poly car seen from behind with a black racing stripe, a wide rear light bar with red tail lamps, and a dark roof and glass. That reads most like a **Ford Mustang (S197/S550-era fastback) with a Shelby-style stripe**, though the proportions are closer to a generic muscle coupe than any single exact generation.
Looks like a 2008–2014 Subaru Impreza WRX STI (GR/GV generation) sedan, based on the four-door body, rear wing and hood-stripe styling. It's a low-poly interpretation, so the match is approximate.
It looks like a 2010s-era Subaru WRX STI-style sedan (fourth-gen-ish body), with the rear wing, hood scoop vents and front bumper intake.
It looks like a low-poly orange Ford Mustang (S550 generation, 2015–2017 facelift) with black racing stripes, though the stylised form makes that a best guess.

It looks like a low-poly, Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution-style sports sedan (roughly 2008–2015 era, e.g. the Lancer Evolution X), though the body shape is generic enough that it's a loose resemblance rather than a confident match.
It looks like a low-poly take on a BMW M3 (G80 generation, 2021+), based on the quad round taillights, twin exhausts in the rear bumper, and the rear-deck spoiler.
It most resembles a Nissan Skyline R34 GT-R (fourth-generation, R32–R34 era), with its sedan body, rear wing and five-spoke wheels, though the low-poly build makes it a loose match.
Closest match: a 1970s–80s mid-engine wedge like the Lamborghini Countach (LP400 generation), though a top-down view makes that a low-confidence call.
Closest match: a Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution (roughly the Evo IX/X generation), though it's a stylised model, so the match is loose.
Loosely a 2015–2017 Ford Mustang (S550) coupe, with racing stripes and a rear wing, though it's a stylised caricature rather than an exact match.
It looks like a **Ford Mustang S550 (2015–2020)**, probably a Shelby GT500-style car, judging by the twin hood stripes, hood scoops and front splitter.
Closest match is a 2008-2014 Subaru Impreza WRX STI sedan (GD/GR generation), though this is a low-confidence guess from a stylised low-poly render.
BMW M3 / M4 of the G80/G82 generation (2021 onward), going by the tall twin-kidney grille with vertical slats and the angular red headlights.
It looks most like a Nissan Skyline R32 GT-R (second generation, 1989–1994): the fastback coupe profile, short overhangs and the rear wing read as R32-era.
Closest match is a late-1960s American muscle coupe, such as a 1969 Dodge Charger or Chevrolet Camaro, though the top-down view makes the exact make and generation uncertain.
It most loosely resembles a 2015–2017 Ford Mustang (S550) with racing stripes, though the low-poly simplification makes the match approximate.
Looks most like a stylised **Ford Mustang** (S550-era fastback coupe, with the hood stripes and grille), though the low-poly simplification makes the exact generation a guess.

It looks like a **Ford Mustang (S550, 2015–2017 facelift era)**, judging by the twin racing stripes, the horizontal-bar grille and the sloped headlights, though this low-poly front view is ambiguous enough that it could also be a Shelby GT350/GT500-style variant.
Closest match: a 1993–2002 Chevrolet Camaro (4th generation), though the low-poly simplification makes it a loose match.
Closest match is a 2015–2017 Ford Mustang (S550), though the low-poly front view makes this a low-confidence guess.
It most closely resembles a 1980s Mazda RX-7 (FB generation), in a stylised, wedge-shaped, rear-spoiler form.
Most likely a 1968–70 Dodge Charger (second generation), though the top-down view makes it a low-confidence guess.
